parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the flush button of the toilet, typically made of stainless steel for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism to release water into the bowl for cleaning.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position after release.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the toilet seat, made of polypropylene plastic for comfort, hygiene, and ease of cleaning.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable sitting surface for the user and can be lifted or lowered as needed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge to open or close over the toilet bowl.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toilet, made of ceramic material for strength, water resistance, and ease of cleaning.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat and contains the bowl and flushing channel for waste disposal.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structural component anchored to the floor or wall.
